task.title: To switch connections
task.shortdesc: The X-Author Designer ribbon is fully enabled. Now you can start designing an app or

step.cmd: In the X-Author Designer or X-Author for Excel ribbon menu, click Switch Connection.
Select a connection from the drop-down menu. The login window opens.
Enter your password to log in.

result.p: The X-Author Designer ribbon is fully enabled. Now you can start designing an app or using existing apps.

You can revoke the connection if you no longer need to connect to an instance. After a connection is revoked, you will no longer see that connection as an option when switching or managing connections.
